_comment: Offline trust anchor for composed/v2. Two PRODUCTION public keys, each copied verbatim from its issuer's live JWKS: agentgraph-security-v1 (AgentAvow, https://agentgraph.co/.well-known/jwks.json) and agentid-2026-03 (AgentID, https://getagentid.dev/.well-known/jwks.json). The APS slot is structural (unsigned) in v2; aeoess's key joins this JWKS when the APS slot is signed.
